steps.say: MAS is a cytokine storm inside rheumatic disease with falling counts and sky-high ferritin. Still disease and lupus are the usual hosts. Bone marrow hemophagocytosis is the sealer of it. Fever that stops spiking with crashing counts is MAS. Pathophysiology involves failed killing, and storms are driven by T cells with NK cells.
steps.tx: A cytokine storm inside rheumatic disease is **MAS** (macrophage activation syndrome): runaway macrophages with T-cell help devouring blood cells (**hemophagocytosis**) across systemic JIA, adult-onset Still disease, and SLE. Spiking fever that goes flat while counts crash indicates MAS, never active Still disease.

vis.alt: Hemophagocytosis with engulfed erythrocytes in macrophage activation syndrome.
vis.caption: Macrophages engulfing red cells define hemophagocytosis. Falling counts with extreme ferritin confirm MAS. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Still disease is high counts while MAS is falling counts. Platelets below 181000 with white cells below 4000 are the markers of the flip. ESR in sudden paradoxical fall is the hallmark of consumed fibrinogen. The flip from high to low counts is the alarm.
steps.tx: High counts mean active Still disease while falling counts mean MAS: platelets sinking to **181,000** per microliter or less, leukocytes to **4,000** or less, and **ESR** (sedimentation rate) dropping suddenly as **fibrinogen** (clotting protein) is eaten. Daily fever that sheds its spikes as platelets sink indicates MAS at once.

steps.say: Hyperferritinemia above 10000 to 50000 is the screening flag with extreme specificity. EULAR Ravelli criteria are the pair of 684 ferritin with 2 lab qualifiers. Triglycerides above 156 with fibrinogen below 360 complete the set. Ferritin is drawn in every febrile Still patient.
steps.tx: Screen with **ferritin** (iron storage protein): readings above **10,000 ng** per mL scream MAS with rare false alarms. The 2016 **Ravelli** rule wants ferritin past **684 ng** per mL plus any 2 qualifiers from platelets **181,000** or less, **AST** past **48 units** per L, **triglycerides** past **156 mg** per dL, and **fibrinogen 360 mg** per dL or less. Five-figure ferritin in a febrile rheumatic patient is MAS until proven otherwise.

steps.say: HLH-2004 needs 5 of 8 across fever, spleen, counts, lipids, marrow, NK function, ferritin, and sCD25. Ferritin above 500 with sCD25 above 2400 are the counters toward it. HScore above 169 gives above 90 percent probability. Either system confirms HLH.
steps.tx: Five hits from eight clinch **HLH-2004**: fever, big spleen, two-lineage cytopenia, high triglycerides or low fibrinogen, tissue hemophagocytosis, weak or missing NK killing, ferritin from **500 ng** per mL upward, and **sCD25 from 2,400 units** per mL upward. Nine-variable **HScore** at **169 points** or more means above **90 percent** probability. Either tally confirms HLH while genes are still pending.

steps.say: Primary HLH is genetic killer-cell failure in infants while secondary follows EBV, lymphoma, or autoimmunity. PRF1, UNC13D, STXBP2, and XIAP are the heads of the gene list. Age with trigger is the splitter of the two. Genetics never delay therapy.
steps.tx: Primary HLH is genetic cytotoxicity failure (**PRF1**, UNC13D, STXBP2, **XIAP** genes) in infants and young children, while secondary HLH follows **EBV**, CMV, leishmania, T and NK lymphoma, or autoimmune disease at any age. Infant HLH without trigger indicates genetics, while EBV or lymphoma with HLH indicates secondary disease. Treatment starts before gene results return.

steps.say: First-line anakinra 2 to 10 mg per kg daily is the controller of MAS rapidly without etoposide in most Still cases. HLH protocols are the pair of dexamethasone with etoposide for the rest. CNS disease is the adder of intrathecal methotrexate. Emapalumab is the rescuer of refractory primary disease.
steps.tx: Pulse **methylprednisolone 30 mg** per kg daily with **anakinra from 2 to 10 mg** per kg (IL-1 blockade) calms MAS within hours, and Still-disease MAS usually never meets **etoposide** (a topoisomerase poison). **HLH-94** with HLH-2004 couples **dexamethasone** to etoposide, plus intrathecal **methotrexate** with hydrocortisone when disease enters the CNS. Fully human **emapalumab** (interferon-gamma blockade) salvages refractory primary HLH at **63 percent** response. Still MAS indicates anakinra first.

vis.alt: Salmon-pink rash with quotidian fever in adult-onset Still disease.
vis.caption: Salmon rash with spiking fever precedes the MAS flip. Falling counts after this rash trigger ferritin testing. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: EBV-HLH is taken care of by rituximab deleting infected B cells. Malignancy HLH is taken care of by cancer chemotherapy. Transplant is the cure of primary HLH alone. The trigger is the picker of the therapy while steroids are the bridge of all.
steps.tx: **EBV**-HLH takes **rituximab** to delete infected B cells, emptying the viral reservoir at its source. Malignancy HLH takes disease-directed chemotherapy aimed at the driving lymphoma clone. Primary HLH cures only with allogeneic **transplant** replacing the defective immune system. Trigger-directed therapy runs while dexamethasone bridges all forms, because hyperinflammation kills before triggers yield.

vis.alt: Systemic JIA with quotidian fever, rash, and arthritis as the MAS host.
vis.caption: Systemic JIA hosts most childhood MAS. Fever losing its spikes with falling counts triggers rescue. Credit: StewardMD.

steps.say: Falling counts with ferritin above 10000 in a febrile rheumatic patient is MAS. Five of eight or HScore above 169 is HLH. Anakinra leads Still MAS while etoposide protocols cover the rest. Triggers are hunted in parallel.
steps.tx: Falling platelets at **181,000** or below with ferritin above **10,000** in febrile Still disease or lupus is MAS. **5 of 8** HLH-2004 items or **HScore 169** or more is HLH. **Anakinra 2 to 10 mg** per kg leads Still MAS, **dexamethasone** with **etoposide** covers the rest, and **rituximab** with chemotherapy or **transplant** answers the trigger. Counts with ferritin are checked daily.
